description: Implementation of the DigitalProductService, managing digital product files, including adding files, retrieving by product, deleting, and saving/updating digital products within an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: DigitalProductServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation managing digital product files and their association with products and stores, providing CRUD and file management operations.

methods.name: addProductFile
methods.description: Associates a digital product with a physical file, saves the digital product, and updates the product status to virtual.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a DigitalProduct by associated Product and MerchantStore.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a DigitalProduct and its associated file; updates the product to non-virtual.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persists a new or existing DigitalProduct and marks the associated Product as virtual.
